text:
marie: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — updates rate-limit docs for tiered limits, clarifies burst credits, and adds dashboard panel screenshot. Need quick review before EOD. :hourglass:

josh: looking now. quick q — are 'burst credits' a first-class term? Product calls used 'burst behavior' earlier. We should be consistent.

marie: product okayed 'burst credits' as the UX term in Console. I added a parenthetical note 'aka burst behavior' for backward-compat. Also added an SDK snippet showing how to read limit headers.

alan: can you paste the snippet here? I want to confirm header names and casing.

marie: pasted snippet in PR comment:
```js
// example: read rate limit headers
const res = await fetch('/v1/responses');
console.log(res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-remaining'));
console.log(res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-reset'));
```

priya: quick docs dash note — in the Grafana JSON I referenced $env_region but the PR currently hardcodes `us-west1`. Can you switch to the var so customers can preview other regions? Also the panel title needs to indicate "per-route" vs "per-key".

josh: also CI flagged a broken image link in the PR — `/images/quota-heatmap.png` returned 404 in the preview.

marie: fixed the image path and pushed a new commit. @deploy-bot can you re-run the docs CI? The lint check was flaky earlier.

deploy-bot: CI queued: docs-lint, linkcheck, grafana-validate.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on PR 482 — missing fenced language on two code blocks (line ~120 and ~218). See logs.

simon: I'll take the lint fixes. Minor: the migration guide for SDK v3 should explicitly show the header rename mapping from `x-rate-limit-*` to `rate-limit-*` (we changed naming in infra in 2025). Otherwise customers will be confused during migration.

alan: yes — add a short callout: "Legacy header names (x-rate-limit-*) map to new `rate-limit-*` headers; both are supported but will be deprecated in older SDKs."

marie: added the migration callout and updated the Grafana JSON to use `$env_region`. Also fixed the fenced code blocks. Pushed the changes.

priya: LGTM for content. One small nit: change panel subtitle from "Usage" to "Usage (tokens/min)" so unit is explicit. After that I'll approve.

josh: verified image renders in preview now. Approving once Priya approves. :thumbsup:

marie: great, thanks! Merged the PR and updated release notes. Merge commit at 1865432135. Closing thread. :tada:
